label: Gmail
description: Sends an email, or reads messages from a mailbox.

params.name: limit
params.label: Limit
params.hint: How many messages to fetch, newest first.

docs.summary: Sends an email, or reads messages out of a mailbox.
docs.mode: Sending runs once per item — one item in, one email out. Reading runs once and returns one item per message.
docs.when: Use it when a person needs to be told something, and Slack is not where they are. Reading is for workflows that start from what is in an inbox.

params.name: operation
params.text: `send` sends one email per item. `getAll` fetches messages and returns one item each.

params.name: to
params.text: The recipient. Usually an expression, so each item can email a different person.

params.name: subject
params.text: The subject line. Plain text or an expression.

params.name: message
params.text: The body. Plain text or an expression.

examples.label: One email per item, addressed from the item
One summary email instead of forty

gotchas: Sending runs once per item. Forty items means forty emails — aggregate first if you meant one.
A missing credential is a 401, not a silent no-send. Read the status in the run log.
